PLAYER GUIDES / UPDATED 12 OCTOBER 2026

Player guides

Short, task-based guides for what you can do in the game today. Every key, number and recipe is traced to the game's source code, and planned features stay marked as planned.

Written against Voxelgame main dd29d91 · committed 10 October 2026 · every claim is traced to the source in the feature ledger
01 / WRITTEN

Written guides

  1. GUIDE 01 · 7 min read · New players

    Getting started: your first session

    The start menu, creating a world, moving, reading the screen, opening your pack, switching modes, and saving safely.

  2. GUIDE 02 · 3 min, then look things up · Everyone

    Controls reference

    The essential keys, the keys that change meaning with context, and a searchable list of every control in the audited game.

  3. GUIDE 03 · 8 min read · New players

    Your first survival day

    Switch to survival, read the four bars, drink, eat, mine, make stone tools, cook, build a home and avoid the real dangers.

  4. GUIDE 04 · 5 min, then look things up · Everyone

    Crafting and recipes

    How the Craft tab works, which ingredients can be mixed, the quick-craft trap, and the complete recipe list with amounts.

  5. GUIDE 05 · 4 min read · Everyone

    Install, update and find your worlds

    Install Voxelgame on Linux, Windows or macOS, update it by running the installer again, and find the folders that hold your worlds.

  6. GUIDE 06 · 5 min read · Everyone

    Fixing startup, sound and save problems

    Find the error message, check your graphics driver and sound players, and recover a world that will not load.

  7. GUIDE 07 · 4 min read · Everyone

    Hunting, weapons and animals

    Animals never attack. Learn the melee, throwing, bow and rifle controls, and what each kill gives you.

  8. GUIDE 08 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Seasons and the look of the world

    A year lasts 80 minutes. Each season changes colours and light. Blocks, building and tools stay the same. Snow and thinner leaves are planned, not in the game yet.

  9. GUIDE 09 · 5 min read · Everyone

    Maps and finding your way back

    Use the compact and fullscreen maps, the biome locator, Journal places and destinations. Keep a build easy to find after a long trip.

  10. GUIDE 10 · 6 min read · Everyone

    Building basics and creative tools

    Place whole blocks and half-metre pieces, use the creative brushes, copy and paste, and undo your work.

  11. GUIDE 11 · 5 min read · Everyone

    Sailing a boat

    Launch and pack up the Small sailing boat, take the helm, set the sails, tack upwind and save your boats.

  12. GUIDE 12 · 4 min read · Everyone

    Settings and performance

    Where the settings are, what each General, Audio and Debug row does, and which ones to lower on a slower computer.

  13. GUIDE 13 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Study Grove focus timer

    How to open Study Grove, run focus and break phases, change the lengths and choose a backdrop.

  14. GUIDE 14 · 4 min read · Everyone

    Explosives: TNT and dynamite

    Place and light TNT with G, read the blast reach, throw dynamite, and see which explosives survival can craft.

  15. GUIDE 15 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Day, night and weather

    A day lasts 20 minutes. Weather follows a 30-minute pattern in every world, rain stops at roofs, and creative players can hold the time and weather.

  16. GUIDE 16 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Saves and world files

    A world save keeps your character, inventory, settings and every block you changed. Each world is capped at 200,000 changed blocks and 8 MiB.

  17. GUIDE 17 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Animal spawning, calls and spawn eggs

    Wild animals appear around you as you explore, depending on the biome. Up to 36 can be around you at once. Creative mode has a spawn egg for each of the 94 species.

  18. GUIDE 18 · 5 min read · Everyone

    Aiming, camera and on-screen feedback

    Read the crosshair and looking-at card, steady ranged aim, set the camera effects and follow the status line and collection feed.

  19. GUIDE 19 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Caves and geological landmarks

    Some hills have a cave with one of three layouts. Rare large sites such as meteor craters, amethyst gorges and lava tubes appear on certain ground. Caves are small and bounded, not deep networks.

  20. GUIDE 20 · 3 min read · Everyone

    Not in the game yet

    Fire, lava, waterfalls and dripstone, doors and furniture, and player skins are not in this version. Here is what is missing and what you can do today.
